title: Pubnet ledger 49542152: real CHANGE_TRUST_CANNOT_DELETE
why: A ledger the network actually closed that holds this arm: ChangeTrustResult::CHANGE_TRUST_CANNOT_DELETE. Generated entries had none of them, so a reader's handling of them was never exercised on bytes stellar-core wrote under real traffic.

must_not_include.because: named in the envelope of a failed transaction; only the fee payer and the source changed (candidate)

notes: Found by xdrcheck-corpus mine (the smallest ledger of the sampled range that shows the arm). Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture; expect is the reference extractor's output. Focus: apply index 92 carries ChangeTrustResult::CHANGE_TRUST_CANNOT_DELETE.
caps_note: Classic shapes found in real traffic; no single CAP
